theme_strategy.description: A high-tech interface for exploring lost history. Think 'Minority Report' meets 'Public Library'. Dark, immersive backgrounds with electric highlights to signal discovery.

headings.usage: Hero titles, Section headers, Similarity percentages

monospace.usage: Data coordinates, Year numbers, Loading states

rules: Never use pure black (#000000) for cards.
Always add 1px border to cards with 10% opacity.
Use 'subgrid' for alignment within cards if possible.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-black font-bold uppercase tracking-wide hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(0,255,148,0.5)] transition-all

cards.result_card: bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10 rounded-xl hover:border-primary/50 transition-colors group relative overflow-hidden

inputs.search_bar: bg-white/5 border border-white/10 focus:border-primary text-white placeholder-white/30 rounded-full px-6 py-4 text-lg

motion_guidelines.scanning_effect: A horizontal line moving top-to-bottom over images (scanline).
motion_guidelines.hover_states: Instant color shift, slow glow decay.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. SETUP: Install fonts 'Unbounded' and 'Inter' in index.html immediately.
2. THEME: Force dark mode in tailwind config. Do not allow light mode toggle for MVP.
3. COMPONENT: Create a 'ScannerFrame' component that adds a moving green line over any child image.
4. LAYOUT: The Results Gallery must use a Masonry or Bento layout, not a simple grid. Faces vary in aspect ratio.
5. INTERACTION: When a user uploads a photo, show a 'biometric analysis' animation before fetching results.
6. ACCESSIBILITY: Ensure the Green (#00FF94) text is only used on very dark backgrounds. Use White for body text.
universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients for backgrounds, use solid dark colors + noise texture.
Avoid standard card shadows; use 1px borders instead.
